first.rationale: A targeted promotional-pricing test directly addresses the competitor-driven loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. It should be guarded because discounting can harm long-term value; the concurrent activation and onboarding declines make onboarding simplification a strong alternative pending source verification.

final.rationale: Run a shortened/simplified onboarding experiment. The verified prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding-completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected because its verified retention decline makes it unsuitable for the primary objective despite competitive pressure.
